owner: VS Code executes. Cursor prepares and does not mark these PASS.

environment.docker: required; the suite starts and removes its own container
environment.role: suite creates auth_proof_login and auth_proof_system_login and the bootstrap roles; Cursor does not run this

items.fixtureSetup: beforeAll runs the pinned image, waits until PostgreSQL accepts connections, applies compileSyntheticAuthFixtureSql and compileAuthBootstrapSql, and points AUTH_DATABASE_URL and AUTH_SYSTEM_DATABASE_URL at the container.
items.cleanup: afterAll closes clients and runs docker rm --force on the container it created. If the process is killed first, remove any container named ue-auth-v2-*.

success: Privilege inspection failures and gaps are empty, including EXECUTE only for the owner or the listed callers of auth_revoke_pending_invites, auth_revoke_invites_on_user_change and auth_revoke_invites_on_membership_change.
Demotion, membership removal and suspension make the pending token fail, and restoring admin, is_active or lifecycle_state does not clear revoked_at or let that token succeed.
A bridge with parentSessionId is allowed only while that parent session is active, unexpired and the same user.
A bridge with neither a live parent nor device_info.bridgeClass provider-no-parent is denied.
A bridge with parentSessionId null and bridgeClass provider-no-parent is allowed only while that bridge row is itself live.
denial: Forged inviter, foreign organization, revoked parent, expired parent and a parentless bridge without the provider class confer nothing.
Do not record PASS from the compiler-only describe. That describe runs when AUTH_NATIVE_PROOF is unset and does not exercise PostgreSQL.

items.failureInterpretation: A privilege failure means the new revoke grants or function owner, SECURITY DEFINER, search_path or EXECUTE list do not match AUTH_FUNCTION_EXPECTATIONS. A redemption success after reactivation means revoked_at was cleared or the live-inviter predicate ignored it. A parentless bridge that is allowed without bridgeClass means the old IS NULL parent clause is still installed.
items.recovery: docker rm --force the suite container. Do not point the suite at a shared database. Re-run only after the implementation commit that introduced the assertion is the one under test.

environment.UE_AUTH_OWNER_URL: superuser URL of an empty disposable database; the local URL shape is the comment at the top of the test file
environment.docker: not started by this file; provide PostgreSQL 16 yourself
environment.role: the suite creates auth_concurrency_login and auth_concurrency_system_login and grants the gateway roles

items.fixtureSetup: Applies compileSyntheticAuthFixtureSql and compileAuthBootstrapSql on UE_AUTH_OWNER_URL, creates the two login roles, and seeds concurrency-inviter as an active admin of organization 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111 only.
items.cleanup: Drop the disposable database. The suite closes its clients and does not drop the database. The redemption-first test adds and then drops trigger concurrency_wait; if the test is killed during the wait, set user_management.concurrency_gate.open to true and drop the trigger before retrying.

success: Offboarding that commits while redemption waits returns success false and Invalid or expired invite, sets revoked_at, and inserts no user.
Membership removal that commits while redemption waits does the same.
Rollback of a suspend releases the inviter lock, leaves revoked_at null, lets one redemption succeed, and makes the replay fail.
An offboarding UPDATE waits while another session holds pg_advisory_xact_lock on auth-inviter:concurrency-inviter, then commits after ROLLBACK.
Reactivation does not clear revoked_at and the suspended token still fails.
An invitation for organization 22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222 fails. The organization A redemption creates a membership only in organization A.
Redemption that holds the lock first succeeds. The waiting suspend then revokes the still-pending sibling and does not revoke the accepted invitation.
denial: Five tests stay skipped unless UE_AUTH_CONCURRENCY_PROOF=1. A skipped run is not evidence.
Do not point UE_AUTH_OWNER_URL at a shared or production database. Bootstrap raises if auth policies already exist.

items.failureInterpretation: Lock timeout not observed on the redemption-first test means redemption never held auth-inviter:<user> through the user insert, or the gate trigger did not run. A redemption that succeeds after the offboarding commit means the re-read or the same-statement revoke did not happen. A sibling that stays unrevoked after the later suspend means the trigger did not update pending invites. A 500ms lock-wait failure means the second offboarding did not block.
items.recovery: Drop the disposable database and retry. Do not weaken a timeout into a mock. Do not grant the system role a general invites UPDATE to make a failure pass.

nextEngineeringAction: Do not start Docker and do not set AUTH_NATIVE_PROOF or UE_AUTH_CONCURRENCY_PROOF in Cursor.
